title: Rent Receipt Generator
name: Rent Receipt
summary: Monthly rent receipts, ready to submit for HRA.
description: Create a rent receipt, or a set of up to 12 for a period, with tenant, landlord, property and amount. Preview instantly and download as PDF.

print.title: Rent Receipt
print.certify: This is to certify that {tenant} has paid {amount} to landlord {landlord} towards rent for the month of {month} (acknowledged receipt enclosed).
print.certify_period: This is to certify that {tenant} has paid {amount} to landlord {landlord} towards rent for the period {period} (acknowledged receipt enclosed).
print.reimburse: Please reimburse the above amount. I further declare that what is stated above is correct and true.
print.received_text: Received from {tenant} the sum of {amount} towards rent for the month of {month}. Received by {role} {receiver}.
print.subtitle: Monthly tenancy payment acknowledgement
print.ack: I, {landlord}, hereby acknowledge receipt of rent amounting to {amount} from {tenant} for the tenancy period of {period}.
print.premises: The rent pertains to the premises situated at {address}, and this receipt is issued as proof of payment for accounting, tax and reimbursement purposes.
print.term_1: This receipt confirms payment only for the period mentioned above.
print.term_2: Utility charges, penalties or maintenance are excluded unless stated separately.
print.term_3: The parties affirm that the details in this receipt are true and correct.
